memory_candidates.content: For an extension's .claude/CLAUDE.md merge source, check EXTENSION.md first, not merge-sources/claudemd.md: only the core and literature extensions use the merge-sources/claudemd.md convention; every other extension (confirmed for sapience) merges EXTENSION.md's own body directly into .claude/CLAUDE.md. Confirm by byte-comparing the candidate file against the deployed CLAUDE.md section before editing either.

When reconciling a cross-repo hazard note after its named companion/escape-valve task lands, check for dangling same-file cross-references the resolved bullet leaves behind (e.g. 'the write-grant residual above' pointing at nothing in that file) -- removing the resolved bullet can silently orphan such a reference if it isn't grepped for first.
